messages.en: What are you doing?
The Cosmo photo is pretty, right?
I'm living a busy life again today.
As a reward, I want to go play Bastion.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Oh right.
What I did today is a secret.

messages.ko: 금발하고 첫날 사진 보여주려고 어그로 끌었다
messages.en: I was just baiting you so I could show you my first-day blonde photos.
Sorry.
This was probably
the day the members said I looked handsome.
The reason I couldn't send selfies
was because of my hair dye.
Pretty exciting, right?
They're fresh fries.
Fresh out of the fryer and so satisfying.
Anyway, if I give you one spoiler...
I ate two packs of ramen while filming.
Then I fell asleep on the bed.
So I ended up filming with a super puffy face.
I probably look kind of sleepy.
You'll see later...
No, don't look...
No, do look...
I'll watch with one eye closed.
Watch with your eyes half-open.
Wow, I'm still sleepy.
This is driving me crazy.
Still, earlier than I expected,
I'm on my way home.
So I'm happy.
I want to eat plums.
They sound so good.
You're eating again..?
Where did you learn to say that?
Hmph.

messages.ko: 저녁 뭐먹을까 목감기라 뜨끈한거 먹고싶은데 추천해 주 ㅏ...
messages.en: What should I eat for dinner? I have a sore throat, so I want something warm...
Eat gukbap.
Jiwoo unnie and I have been saying since earlier that we wanted gukbap.
We've been talking about it nonstop.
I really want beef spine.
I felt too bad for my mom, so I switched to cow instead.
I'm still living off my mom...
Don't do that. Just eat beef spine instead...
Hexagon has to live off the leader's bone marrow.
I'll gladly give it to you.
Take my wallet too~
Hayeon, I'll just buy one car then.
Hmm~!
Ahㅏㅎㅎㅎ
Uh... I don't need a police car.
Oh, that's not what you meant~?
About the story Yubin unnie told about 'Lovely'...
What was it again?
Oh, the one where I cried ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
No but,
It was probably not long after I joined.

messages.ko: 넥스트 만 따로 남아서 항상 모든 트리플에스 유닛 곡을
messages.en: Only the NXT members stayed behind, and we always had to memorize every tripleS unit song.
We had them all memorized.

messages.ko: 그러다 행사였나 머 무대를 서야된다고 급하게 러블춤을 혼자 따오라능겨
messages.en: Then, because we suddenly had to perform at an event or on a stage, I was told to learn the choreography for 'Lovely' by myself as quickly as possible.

messages.ko: 난 춤을 길게 배우지도 못했고 혼자 따는법도 모르는데
messages.en: I hadn't been learning dance for very long, and I didn't even know how to learn choreography on my own.
So when they told me to do it, I just felt completely lost.
I worked hard watching videos by myself and asking the unnies for help.
Then we filmed a practice video with the teacher.

messages.ko: 나한테 집중돼있고 영상도 찍으니까 부담스러워서 계속 틀리고
messages.en: Since all the attention and the camera were on me, I felt pressured and kept making mistakes.

messages.ko: 틀릴때마다 계속 춰주는 언니들한테 미안하고 막
messages.en: Every time I made a mistake, I felt so sorry for the unnies who had to keep dancing with me.
I got frustrated with myself.
So I started crying.

messages.ko: 근데 우니까 더 집중이 안돼서 미치겠고
messages.en: But once I started crying, I couldn't focus at all, and it drove me crazy.
During a short break, I watched the video by myself.
Sniffling while practicing the choreography.
Somehow, I managed to finish filming it.
I thought if I filmed with a tearful face, they'd definitely make me film it again.
So I tried my best to look cheerful.
That's what I remember doing while filming.

messages.ko: 정하연 운썰 하면 멤버들 다 그날 얘기만 할듯
messages.en: Whenever people talk about 'Jeong Hayeon's crying story,' the members would probably all bring up that day.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 근데 회사가 나쁘고 쌤이 나쁘고 그렇다기보단
messages.en: It's not that the company or the teacher did anything wrong.
The situation just couldn't be helped~
Now I can laugh about it. ㅋㄹㅌㄹㅋㅋ
But when I told this story
to my mom,
she felt sad too.

messages.ko: 근데 이런 나 자신에대한 충격이 한번씩 있을때마다
messages.en: Still, whenever I go through moments where I'm shocked by myself,
I do end up growing.
I become more objective about myself.
What kind of tribe is the 'objective tribe'? Ooga booga.
Just let that one slide....
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
I kind of want jokbal though.
Wrapped in lettuce.
You're eating again..?
Looks like the banned word filter isn't working yet~?

messages.en: What if I type 'e a t again'? Then it won't get caught.
Checking.

to block them all.

messages.en: Chaewon said poop is her favorite too. You two are the same.
I don't like poop.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
